साल 2026 में सूर्या ने बॉक्स ऑफिस पर कर दिया है बड़ा धमाका। 🎬
फिल्म Karuppu से उन्होंने глобаल लेवल पर तीन सौ करोड़ का आंकड़ा पार किया और यह उनके करियर की सबसे बड़ी सोलो हिट बनी। 🤩
इसके बाद Vishwanath & Sons ने दो सौ बारह दशमलव तीन चार करोड़ की कमाई की। 💰
अब उनकी लेटेस्ट रिलीज Scene ने सिर्फ तीन दिन में एक सौ सोलह दशमलव चार पांच करोड़ कमा लिए हैं। 📈
इन तीनों फिल्मों को मिलाकर इस साल उनका कुल कलेक्शन छह सौ त्रेपन दशमलव सात नौ करोड़ हो चुका है। ✨
रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक Scene फिल्म के दो सौ करोड़ क्लब में शामिल होने की उम्मीद है और क्या वह सात सौ करोड़ का जादुई आंकड़ा छू पाएंगे? 🤔

ctx.title: Box Office: Suriya Crosses 600 Crore Worldwide In 2026; Is 700 Crore The Next Target?
ctx.summary:
With Karuppu, Vishwanath & Sons and Scene, Suriya has comfortably gone past the 600 crore mark at the worldwide box office in 2026. 
 The post  Box Office: Suriya Crosses 600 Crore Worldwide In 2026; Is 700 Crore The Next Target?  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
After desperately waiting for a successful film for a long time, Suriya finally made a smashing comeback at the box office in 2026. He started the year with Karuppu, which marked his entry into the 300 crore club worldwide. It was followed by another money spinner, Vishwanath & Sons. Now, even his latest release, Scene, is doing well and has comfortably crossed the 100 crore mark in just 3 days. With this, the Kollywood star has crossed the 600 crore mark this year.
Karuppu, directed by RJ Balaji, turned into the biggest solo success of Suriya’s career, grossing a massive 315 crore globally. It helped him taste his first success after 10 years. It was followed by Vishwanath & Sons, which also turned out to be a money-spinner. It grossed a solid 212.34 crore . With these two films, he reached a strong total of 527.34 crore .
Scene has already become Suriya’s fourth-highest-grossing film worldwide, grossing 116.45 crore in 3 days. With this, the actor’s cumulative box office total stands at a whopping 643.79 crore this year. This marks his highest-grossing year ever.
Take a look at the worldwide collection of Suriya’s 2026 releases:
Scene is enjoying mostly favorable word-of-mouth among audiences, so it is likely to do well in the coming days. Yes, Ramayana is performing beyond expectations in Tamil Nadu, but Suriya’s film will see its share of audiences. The film has a shot at entering the 200-crore club worldwide, which means the actor is likely to hit the 700-crore mark in 2026. He needs just 56.21 crore more, which looks achievable.
From delivering no success in the last 10 years to making a strong comeback with three money spinners, Suriya is truly having a gala time in his career!
